summary: Iter98 — Manual LMS-to-CRM school link (backend + frontend). All 7 backend pytest cases pass, and the frontend manual-link flow (button, modal, search, transfer/merge affordances, close) works end-to-end on Active Schools cards.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /schools/{id}/link-lms currently accepts a raw dict payload — consider a Pydantic model (LinkLmsPayload) so 400s are enforced by schema instead of manual strip checks.

DELETE /schools/{id}/link-lms uses matched_count==0 to 404 but does not check if lms_school_id was actually present; behaviour still correct but response is silently identical for both cases (minor UX).
AdminSchoolCRM.jsx is 13.3k lines — well past the 700-line guideline; the LinkLms button/state should ideally live in a small hook or component for maintainability.
LinkLmsSchoolModal shows only the first 100 filtered results silently — add a hint like 'showing top 100 of N' so admins know to refine when list is truncated.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create disposable TEST_* CRM schools via POST /api/schools/inquiry and clean them up in finally blocks. On the transfer/merge cases the LMS ID currently linked to a real CRM row gets moved to the test row and then unlinked; the daily/next auto-sync will re-link the real row via name-match, so no manual data restoration required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 26 real LMS schools available; only one is genuinely orphan (no CRM link). All others are already linked so the PATCH endpoint is exercised as a transfer during tests. LinkLmsSchoolModal renders max 100 filtered rows. School inquiry create endpoint is POST /api/schools/inquiry (singular). support_needed must be a list.

verified_behaviours.GET_/api/lms/all-schools: 200 with count+schools[], includes linked_to for pre-linked rows; ?q= narrows the list
verified_behaviours.PATCH_link_persists_across_import-school: manual-linked CRM row retained, no duplicate created after POST /api/lms/import-schools
verified_behaviours.PATCH_transfer_delete_previous_false: prior CRM row's lms_school_id unset; target gets it
verified_behaviours.PATCH_merge_delete_previous_true: prior CRM row deleted; target gets the link
verified_behaviours.DELETE_/api/schools/{id}/link-lms: clears lms_school_id, lms_link_manual, lms_linked_at, lms_linked_by, last_lms_sync_at
verified_behaviours.FE_link-lms-<id>_buttons: visible on Active/Converted cards; label reads 'Sync LMS' or 'LMS linked'
verified_behaviours.FE_modal: opens with data-testid link-lms-modal; search filters live; link-lms-transfer-<lms_id> + link-lms-merge-<lms_id> present for already-linked rows; link-lms-btn-<lms_id> present for orphans; close returns to list
